content.text: Resolve this upstream compiler issue. Dependencies and a portable Node 16 toolchain are preprovisioned. Edit production files under src/ (excluding __test__.js); build outputs and new test scratch outputs are allowed. Preserve existing test code, fixtures, configuration, package metadata and verification helpers. Do not install packages or use external network access. Run node native-verify.cjs to build and test. The native adaptation omits Nightmare/Electron and these native-incompatible runtime samples: binding-select. Their SSR cases remain enabled. These original, unscored failures may remain: (none). Existing pending tests are preserved. Independent grading retains all official target and required regression titles. Independent grading applies the upstream updated test expectations to a fresh reconstruction of your production changes; do not revert the requested behavior merely to satisfy old snapshots. outroing is not defined with nestedTransitions: true With the `nestedTransitions: true` option, it's possible to end up in a situation where one branch of an `if` block potentially has outros, but another doesn't, and Svelte checks for a non-existent `outroing` variable in the block that doesn't upon update. ```html {#if y} {:else} {x} {/if} ``` Noticed a couple of other things: * we don't really need to update the `if` block at all; perhaps that should be short-circuited anyway * `transitionManager` gets added even though there's no transitions, because it's trying to group the outros (in case `` has some). I wonder if we can separate `groupOutros` from `transitionManager` so that it doesn't get pulled in Run build and test commands one at a time to respect this machine's available memory.
